hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.command' | grep -qE '(^|[;&|[:space:]])git[[:space:]]+commit' || exit 0; b=$(git branch --show-current 2>/dev/null); [ "$(git rev-parse --git-dir 2>/dev/null)" = "$(git rev-parse --git-common-dir 2>/dev/null)" ] || exit 0; case "$b" in task/*) echo "Blocked: main checkout is on $b; commit from that branch's worktree" >&2; exit 2;; esac; exit 0
